messages:
Carla N.: Heads-up — HorizonPay QBR scheduled Wed 10am PT. Need final slides + 2-minute exec asks by EOD Tuesday. Dry-run Tuesday 4pm PT. Can we confirm owners for slide sections and any outstanding demo dependencies?
Matt P.: I can take the performance & cost slide. Need final token-cost delta after quantization. @Kai can you run the 30-min perf snapshot for the dedicated config?
Kai (Eng): Yep. Will run perf snapshot tonight and post results tomorrow AM. Will check both 16-bit and q4 quant configs. ETA 08:30 PT.
Sri R.: I'll own onboarding health & support ticket summary. Quick ask: can CS get last-90day incident SLA graph from Console? If someone from eng-sre can export.
Ashley (SE): I have the onboarding checklist — 4 customers still on step 3 (integration validation). I can surface blockers in the dry-run.
Jordan (PM): Exec ask list: 1) Renewal health (risk flags + mitigation ask) 2) Product roadmap ask (2 small features) 3) Capacity ask — burst policy details. Keep each ask to one slide and an ask bullet.
Carla N.: Good. For renewal health: horizon is at 78% NPS, 3 critical tickets open. Risk: two executive stakeholders haven't been in last 30d. @Matt P. — can you add a slide showing projected cost savings if they move to dedicated with our batching optim? One sentence ask to execs.
Matt P.: Draft slide in drive: https://drive.redwood/horizon-qbr/slides — I added perf numbers placeholder.
Kai (Eng): Perf snapshot completed. Pasted logs into thread: ```
# perf-summary
model: redwood-v1-7b
config: dedicated-2xA100
latency_p95: 210ms -> 170ms (q4)
throughput: 140 tokens/s -> 190 tokens/s (batching)
cost_per_1k_tokens: $1.12 -> $0.72 (quant+batching)
```
Carla N.: Nice. That cost delta looks like a strong ask. Can we have a one-line recommended pricing concession to pair with this? (e.g., 10% committed discount + 60-day adoption window)
Jordan (PM): Recommend 10% commit discount + 60-day pilot access to dedicated. I'll draft the ask slide language.
Sri R.: FYI — Console export attached in drive (support-summary.csv). I'll highlight the 3 critical tickets and proposed remediation timeline in the dry-run.
Ashley (SE): Demo checklist: 1) Live inference with sample Horizon dataset 2) Latency dashboard up 3) Rollback plan slide. I need access to Horizon staging keys — @Carla can you confirm?
Carla N.: Granted staging keys to Ashley and Kai. Also: please rehearse the demo fail case; execs like to see rollback. Dry-run agenda (Tue 4pm): ```
1) 4:00 - 4:05 - Quick context (Carla)
2) 4:05 - 4:15 - Onboarding & health (Sri)
3) 4:15 - 4:25 - Perf & cost ask (Matt/Kai)
4) 4:25 - 4:35 - Product ask & roadmap (Jordan)
5) 4:35 - 4:45 - Demo run + rollback (Ashley/Kai)
6) 4:45 - 4:50 - Exec ask recap & Qs (Carla)
```
Carla N.: Action items: Matt — slide by 11am Tue; Kai — full perf report by 08:30 Tue; Sri — support export + remediation bullets by noon Tue; Ashley — demo readiness + keys check by 3pm Tue; Jordan — final ask copy by EOD Mon. I'll run dry-run and collect feedback. Reply with :thumbsup: when assigned.
Matt P.: :thumbsup:
Kai (Eng): :thumbsup:
Sri R.: :thumbsup:
Ashley (SE): :thumbsup:
Jordan (PM): :thumbsup:
